correctness.rationale: For each block the coefficient E[x_i sign(sum x)]=binom(2m,m)/4^m follows by conditioning and parity. Orthogonality makes E[QF]=prod n_j for every admissible completion; Holder bounds the norm by prod alpha^{-1}. Block sign functions have only odd Fourier degrees so their product first appears in degree r, with exactly the desired one-from-each-block coefficients after scaling. Equality forces the values on Q!=0 and yields the weighted stability bound. Stirling with even/odd substitution gives the displayed correction. value.rationale: The coefficient-prescribed uniform quotient norm of a complete multipartite homogeneous Walsh chaos is a canonical local Banach invariant of a full r-partite hypergraph and is not determined by an arbitrary projection-constant bound. This computes the full multiblock and all-degree family, explicit optimizers and rigidity, quantitative stability, and a parity-sensitive growth law. It also identifies a genuine sharpness mechanism that fails for the triangle hypergraph, providing a motivated benchmark for general Walsh-tail approximation rather than an isolated numerical slice.
